common.tagline: A clearer path to specialist care
common.emergency: Emergency symptoms? RehletShifaa is not an emergency service. Call your local emergency number or seek urgent care now.
common.medicalNotice: RehletShifaa coordinates access to medical review and care. Information provided through the platform does not replace emergency care or a complete clinical assessment. Final medical decisions are made by the treating consultant following appropriate evaluation.

home.title: From Medical Reports to a Clearer Care Path in Egypt
home.intro: Share your medical reports and let RehletShifaa guide your case to the right consultant — across cardiology, adult and pediatric dysphagia (swallowing) rehabilitation, and orthopedics — with your whole journey coordinated before you travel.
home.reassurance: You do not need a diagnosis or the name of a procedure to begin.
assurances: Reviewed by a consultant before you decide to travel
Reports uploaded through private, short-lived links
One coordinator, in Arabic or English, from first contact to follow-up

video.intro: A short, silent visual guide designed to make every next step clear before you share any medical information.

steps.title: Share what you already have
steps.body: Start with your latest report, available tests, and a short note. You do not need a complete file.

steps.title: Your coordinator organizes it
steps.body: One person checks the information, explains what is missing, and stays in contact with you.

steps.title: The right consultant reviews it
steps.body: Your case is directed by clinical need, so you do not have to choose a specialty yourself.

steps.title: You decide with clarity
steps.body: Understand the proposed next step and expected arrangements before deciding about treatment or travel.

home.areasTitle: Three care areas, one coordinated journey

areas.title: Cardiology
areas.body: Consultant-led coronary, structural-heart and rhythm care — from angiography and stents to valve and device procedures.

areas.title: Rehabilitation, Dysphagia & Physical Medicine
areas.body: Adult and pediatric dysphagia (swallowing) rehabilitation — a rare, focused service — with broader rehabilitation, physical medicine and rheumatology.

areas.title: Orthopedics
areas.body: Joint replacement, sports injuries and arthroscopy, and spine and trauma evaluation — with a second opinion before surgery.

home.howIntro: Five steps, each with a named person responsible for it.
home.coordinatorBody: Your Patient Coordinator stays connected with you from your first contact through treatment coordination and follow-up.
home.beforeTitle: Understand Your Care Path Before You Travel
home.beforeBody: Where medically possible, RehletShifaa helps you understand the proposed next steps and expected arrangements before deciding to travel.
home.trustIntro: Coordinating your care means handling sensitive medical information. These are the rules the platform is built on.

trust.title: The consultant decides
trust.body: RehletShifaa coordinates your case. Diagnosis, procedure selection and clinical suitability remain decisions of the treating consultant after appropriate evaluation.

trust.title: Private document handling
trust.body: Reports are uploaded straight to private storage through short-lived links. Files are not published, indexed, or listed anywhere public.

trust.title: Consent before review
trust.body: Your case is submitted only after you give explicit consent for your information to be processed for the purpose of coordinating your care.

trust.title: Emergency comes first
trust.body: If your situation appears urgent, you will be advised to seek emergency care where you are rather than wait to travel.

home.finalBody: You don't need to know the name of the specialty or procedure. Send what you have. We'll help with the next step.
home.finalNote: Sending your case does not commit you to treatment or travel.
home.slogan: Clarity before you travel. Support every step of the way.
home.areasIntro: Start with the area closest to your need. Not sure? Send your case and your coordinator will help direct it.

consultantsPromise.title: We choose consultants, not just specialists.
consultantsPromise.body: Your case is reviewed by a responsible consultant who owns the clinical decision — chosen for senior experience and accountability, so a named person stands behind your care.

travel.title: Professional travel packages, tailored to your needs
travel.intro: When you choose to continue care in Egypt, our professionals can arrange an optional staycation journey around your needs — from your flight to a smooth airport reception and onward stay.

items.title: Flights
items.body: A professional travel plan and flight coordination shaped around your treatment dates and preferences.

items.title: Hotel & stay
items.body: Comfortable stay options for you and a companion, selected for access, comfort and recovery needs.

items.title: Visa assistance
items.body: Practical guidance and documentation support for your medical-travel visa.

items.title: Airport reception
items.body: Personal airport reception and coordinated transfers, so your journey starts calmly from the moment you land.

travel.note: Packages are optional, personalised to your needs, and arranged after your medical proposal. Our travel professionals coordinate the journey from flight to airport reception and stay.
travel.packageLabel: One coordinated package — arranged end to end by our travel professionals

footer.description: Consultant-led coordination of international cardiac care in Egypt, in Arabic and English.
